blocks.text: TP in the Philippines, a global leader in digital business services, was named Sustainability Company of the Year at the 2026 Asia CEO Awards, recognizing its efforts to integrate environmental responsibility, inclusive employment, and community development into its operations. The recognition comes as TP celebrates its 30th year of operations in the Philippines, committing three decades of creating career opportunities and developing Filipino talent to work with global businesses around the world. This year also marks TP’s 9th consecutive Great Place to Work® (GPTW) certification, reinforcing its commitment to building an inclusive workplace where employees can grow and thrive. Held at […]...
